evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Other than the pricing, what are your biggest concern about this month, so I can also take note of and I can answer that within the call.

top_strength: Arden gathered comprehensive logistics details through a thorough room-by-room inventory and covered both key promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full transparency on terms and rates.
coaching_note: After pricing, ask 'Does that feel fair?' and hold silence for the customer to respond; do not skip directly to closing — this gives the customer space to voice hesitation before the ask. Also conduct a final concerns check before asking for the business.
